exposure: time since final menstrual period (FMP, reproductive age)
outcome: composite physical function score (strength, balance, cardiorespiratory fitness)
cohort: The study included 2319 UK women experiencing a natural menopausal transition with up to three repeated measurements of physical function.
finding: Physical function in women in mid-life declined with both chronological and reproductive age, and the decline with reproductive age was independent of chronological age but did not seem to be driven by changes in reproductive hormones.
